title: Japanese-Style Dumpling Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup made with Japanese-style dumplings, tender vegetables, and a hint of floral notes.

ingredients.name: Floral broth
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a high-quality store-bought or homemade broth.

instructions: Bring the floral broth to a boil in a large pot.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add the sesame oil and soy sauce.
Add the Portuguese peas to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional sesame oil and soy sauce if desired.
